Projects

ECS work, systems coursework, and what’s on the bench now.

YearNameStatusNotes
2025–26 Avon shipped / ongoing Git-based coursework platform for Bristol CS: lecturers upload a skeleton zip, every student gets a provisioned repo, tests run at the deadline. Integrates with Blackboard, Moodle, and Canvas — kills the download-zip / upload-zip / something-breaks loop.
Challenging systems work that makes coursework less painful for everyone involved.
2026 SEC 10-K RAG wip Parser and citation-aware chunker for annual filings (section + item). Eval harness for recall, precision, and MRR. Next: hybrid semantic + keyword search, re-ranking, then UI.
Fun, hard retrieval problem with a clear correctness bar.
2025 Distributed Game of Life shipped Concurrency & distributed systems coursework: Game of Life with halo exchange, fault tolerance, running concurrently across machines.
The first time distributed systems clicked as something you feel in the failure modes.
2024 Scotland Yard AI shipped First-year Java project: MiniMax agents for detectives and Mr. X, search to depth ~8 with assorted optimisations.
A clean puzzle where search quality is the whole game.
